title: Dewalt 54V FlexVolt Angle Grinder & Bonus 9Ah XR FlexVolt Li-Ion Battery & 18V-54V Fast Charger - $249 @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: Dewalt 54V FlexVolt Angle Grinder & Bonus 9Ah XR FlexVolt Li-Ion Battery & 18V-54V Fast Charger - $249 @ Bunnings

[Batman110] Not sure, let’s see what we get on Monday.
[OBH] I'm new to the Dewalt ecosystem, does this flexvolt battery work with the normal 18V tools that use the XR batteries?
[Evostar] Yes. Used this 9ah from the Sydney tools deal today cutting 50mm hardwood timber with my 18v circ saw.
[Batman110] Yes, they have a variable pin system for different voltage 18v / 54v use different pins so 54v battery works with 18v tools as well. If you look on the battery it mentions both voltages.
[Free Fall] Also be aware that not all stores will have the battery and charger instore for redemption.
[Batman110] They are cheeky, that’s why they say while stock lasts. But look at the battery and chargers prices, stupidity expensive.
[Free Fall] It's still available at TKD for same price: https://toolkitdepot.com.au/dewalt-flexvolt-2-0-54v-b-l-grin…
[groook] No, same price? Also Bunnings own TKD so don't match them
[Steven123] Doesnt seem mention about instant battery + charger. Could you kindly confirm?
[glennp] It was there, but the listing changed about an hour after this was posted and the free battery/charger offer disappeared. I was in the process of checking out as it changed.
[alexm1] Toolkit pro currently doesn't offer battery and charger
[Batman110] Yes I saw that too. Let me add it to the post.
[donkcat] Really wish they would do a Dewalt jigsaw deal, been waiting like 12 months for 1
[jimojr] Purchase the DEWALT 54V XR 3-Piece Outdoor Combo Kit for $1499 and receive a BONUS DEWALT 54V XR Brushless 530mm Push Mower, valued at $999.
[tqqq] Raided my local bunnings and flipping on fb marketplace. I have ascended into the black market of dewalt dealing
[Clear] Plus the entertainment of Bunnings staff getting so triggered over the Sydney Tools price matching.
[AMLagonda] How can these be out of stock already in WA?
[Sharp324] There was a Sydney Tools offer earlier in the week at this price, people thought it was a pricing error.
A lot price-beat with Bunnings which drained stock for them.
[cnut] Do not do click and collect or delivery. If they don’t have stock of the bonus items, or they forget about the deal, you won’t get them.
Because of the other stores doing the deal, unless they order more batteries, there is about a zero chance you’ll get the bonus items now. Everyone’s been price matching TKD and Sydney Tools already.
@Batman110 might be worth mentioning in the post people should hit the stores in person.
[Batman110] Good point. If anyone can price match or find the item at their local Bunnings store then just go and buy it now.
But look at it this point of view too.
If they are setting up a promo without any stock then it’s a bad reputation too for DeWalt. So they might bring in some more stock from Monday. If you miss out then may be just wait till it comes back in stock.
[cnut] Yeah I reckon they’ll bring more stock. It would be pretty weird if they can’t honor it anywhere.
[alexm1] I went to few store, one of them had battery and the charger but not the angle grinder, y
The other one had the angle grinder but not the charger and refuse to take back order
[qq123456a] last few days already sold out as people get price beat
[Ashmit] The deal for Monday is getting Battery and Charger. However the price still remains above 500. I doubt price will come down at this level.
[jamesorion] Source? You can already get the battery and charger now.
[Ashmit] Actually. Online it was updated. However, This offer was scheduled to be from coming Monday. I went it there to do a price match and also battery and charger. Their manager came an said it is schedule from next week. Then I showed them online, they readily agreed for the same however they showed a page for Fathers day deal scheduled from next week.
[jamesorion] You can price beat Amazon currently and get it for $224.10. It doesn't matter that there is no instant bonus on the Amazon one, as Bunnings isn't the one paying for the in store bonus, Dewalt is. I've never had an issue claiming Dewalt bonuses on price beats, and I've done it multiple times.
[jamesorion] Good luck. Depending on how the staff at your local Bunnings is, it could be painless or you might have to work for it. Don't take no for an answer. If they try to deny the bonuses, ask for the manager. If the manager tries to deny them, ask them to show you where it says in Dewalt's terms that it doesn't apply to Price Beats and point out that the promotion is run by Dewalt, not Bunnings. Hopefully it doesn't come to any of that, though.
The managers at my local are pretty switched on and have never tried to deny a legit price match request from me.
[neRok] "fathers day deal"…
"limited stock"…
this or pokemon cards? damn, its a hard choice!
back in my day they at least put the "trading cards" in the thing you were buying, so that you would buy more of it.
(odd-bodz were in the chips I think, dbz cards were definitely in the cheese, etc)
so there being not even 1 special edition pikachu in the dewalt power tools = fail.
